steps.en: Review and merge the bundle; wire Python, project tests and host skills
steps.zh: 评审合并 bundle，接通 Python、项目测试和宿主技能

steps.en: Shape one capability and request its durable spec
steps.zh: 梳理一个能力并要求写永久规格

steps.en: Guides your agent to write rules, acceptance IDs and reference values
steps.zh: 指引你的 agent 写规则、验收编号与参考值

steps.en: Ratify the spec, start a supervised slice, and approve its exact plan
steps.zh: 批准规格，启动受监督切片并批准确切计划

steps.en: Guides implementation, checks and two authoring hardeners with Owner dispositions
steps.zh: 指引实现、检查和两个加固 agent，由 Owner 裁决

steps.en: Delivers the verified candidate as a PR awaiting human review
steps.zh: 将已验证候选交付为等待人工评审的 PR

value.en: A durable business contract and an explicit evidence trail for a human-reviewed change
value.zh: 为人工评审的改动保留业务契约与明确证据链
